reviews.t: Did not get the switch shown on Amazon and it won't fit.
reviews.x: I got the larger silver switch not the black on as shown on the photo. It will not fit the 76 clipper at all.

reviews.t: it fits and makes my clippers work again.
reviews.x: I bought an Oster 76 classic fulfilled by Amazon.  This somewhat fragile switch was broken off during shipment.  After exploring all my refund and replacement options, I decided to bite the bullet, buy the switch and install it myself and at my cost.  Repair was super easy, took literally less than five minutes.  I spent more time watching youtube videos about how to do it than I did actually repairing the clippers.  I bought a spare switch just in case.  I also now try to limit my amazon purcha

Not genuine OEM and very poor quality. Ordered one switch, went to install, and one of the wires slipped out of the switch. Seller offers no returns, and thinking I just got a bad one, I simply reordered another (need it for a busy salon). Second switch arrives and the same exact problem. This is about the 10th time I've replaced an Oster switch and never had any trouble. These are junk.

The toggle that I received was supposed to fit my Oster 76 clippers but it was thinner that the part I originally have. Therefore I couldn’t fix my clippers due to the gap left. I’ve read great reviews but for me I didn’t have the best of luck

reviews.t: My clippers are like brand new
reviews.x: Easy to replace as I just followed a tutorial on you tube. My clippers work great now as my old switch wire was broken causing my clippers to go off and on. I just wish they would have sold the o ring with it.

I was hoping to not have to buy a new clipper after dropping mine so I bought this switch. It was super easy to install and my clipper was back to normal in a few minutes. Changed it out between clients and was ready to roll.

reviews.t: Great fit, works well.  Saved me a lot of hassle
reviews.x: Perfect fit, easy install using advice from YouTube.  Just had to figure out that there was that round thin nut screwing it in.  Also, photograph your wire arrangement before unscrewing anything.  Wiring differs from videos.

I have no complaints about this product it worked like a charm the only thing I was disappointed with is I thought it would come with the nut used to connect the product to the device but I kept my old one so I was good
False advertising or I was an unlucky one. I didn't receive what is pictured but got, as other reviewers noted, a completely different style of switch. Very disappointed
Perfect. Back in action. No instructions included but there are several YouTube vids on how to replace. Just search oyster switch replacement.
works well, i followed a youtube clip on how to replace it, it is very clear instructions, takes 5-6 minutes

reviews.t: wasted my money on a part that I can't use
reviews.x: doesn't fit the old 76 nclipper. wasted my money on a part that I can't use

reviews.t: I Got What I Paid For
reviews.x: Cashe Beauty provided me the GENUINE Oster control switch.  The generic switches some received and are complaining about are junk and worth <$1. This switch has the built-in leads with ring terminals pre-attached and properly sized to easily change out the broken switch.  You need a Phillips head screw driver and needle nose pliers to complete this repair.  Not rocket science.  Make sure to line up the Keyway tab on the base with the matching slot in the clipper body when you reassemble to ge

reviews.t: Sturdy, but not plug and play.
reviews.x: This is NOT a 1:1 replacement for the original Oster switch.  However, for my needs this is even better.  The switch that I received is a cast metal which is MUCH sturdier than the plastic switch that comes original on an Oster Classic 76.  The contacts are also different than the contacts on the original switch.  This is where some might come across a problem, and why I gave this 3 stars as opposed to 5 Without a basic knowledge of how switches work and what you need to do to connect this switc

I buy from amazon enough to not have to make a special order just for a little switch.  I really need the on/off switch fir my classic 76 clippers. . I made my last order thinking it was enough to add the add on item.. any way Im not a satisfied customer now. . Never had any problems before and now I have to spend extra for something that's $7.. Doesn't make any sense to me.  I need feedback or to resolve my issue.

reviews.t: Oster Switch Fits 76 & A5 Clipper - Single Speed
reviews.x: Don't buy a new "Clipper" before checking" "Springs and Brushes", "Cord" and "Switch". In my case it was actually the "Switch". I bought the "Oster Switch Fits 76 & A5 Clipper - Single Speed" off Amazon as usual. Then I searched and found a "Video" on "YouTube". After that It was "Breezy" . 15 mins. and done. Don't forget to buy the "Retainer Ring" if you don't already have one.

reviews.t: Is not compatible with the Oster 76 Classic clippers and is not as pictured.
reviews.x: I have now tried to order this product 2 times. Each time I purchased 2 to have a backup. Our of the 4 products sent to me, none of them are the right product. They are entirely too large for my classic 76 clipper and the posts are not the same. There is no way to connect this switch to my clippers. The switch on mine is black. This one is metal. I am so disgusted by this.

The little Switch save me $80. I would have had to buy new clippers but because all I had to do was change out the switch for under $7.00 and new they run like new!! My clippers have been acting funny for about 3 years, then went out completely. I’m a hair stylist so it’s  part of what I need for my job and this saved me money and took car of the issue!!

The toggle fell out of my Oster. Bought this replacement.. Not too hard to replace the old one. Put it back together, plugged it in, and it immediately turned on. Flipped the switch the other direction, and it wouldn't turn off. Opened it, checked everything. Guess you really do get what you paid for.

Totally wrong size in amperage needed for my Oster classic 76 (1 AMPS @ 125 VAC) toggle, you sent a 6 AMPS toggle body and toggle switch doesn't even fit, not the same black plastic cover or the braided wiring connectors either. Not a value for your money it could lead to disaster!

Old switch wires came out of the switch. With a small phillips screw driver, it took me less than ten minutes to swap out the old switch and have a working clipper. Suggestion, take a picture of wire connections and switch orientation before removing the old switch.

reviews.t: Prompt arrival, easy installation, works as expected.
reviews.x: The order was received promptly through Amazon Prime. I watched a youtube video on how to install, and the switch works like a charm with my Oster 76 clippers. FYI for the DIY people: Very easy installation. Watch the video and do it yourself to save some money.

Looks and feels heavy duty, unfortunatly its not the part pictured that I was purchasing. The description and picture were a  match to the replacement part I needed. Now I have to find the correct part to fix my clipper.
THis is a great replacement switch for the OSter 76ers. I am so thankful I found this. I was worried I would need a new pair. THis is a quailty product and I am very pleased with it. No issues for me

reviews.t: I'm not good with my hands
reviews.x: Fits well.  If you need help putting it in look at this: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wRcS5Zr27yY&noredirect=1 .  I'm not good with my hands, so that fact that I did this in 15 min is incredible.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the switch fits and works well, restoring their Oster 76 clippers, often installed easily with the help of YouTube tutorials.
Several reviewers received the wrong or a different style of switch than pictured, which did not fit their clippers.
Some reviewers complain the switch is not genuine OEM and is of poor quality, with wires slipping out.
A few reviewers note the switch is not a 1:1 replacement and may differ in material or contacts from the original.
Some reviewers were disappointed that the switch did not include the nut or O-ring needed for installation.
